def ovr : List (κ × β) → (κ → β) → κ → β | [], R => R
theorem ovr_cons (p : κ) (y : β) (M : List (κ × β)) (R : κ → β) : ovr ((p, y) :: M) R = Function.update (ovr M R) p y
theorem ovr_nil (R : κ → β) : ovr ([] : List (κ × β)) R = R
theorem ovr_of_mem {M : List (κ × β)} {p : κ} (hp : p ∈ M.map Prod.fst) (R R' : κ → β) : ovr M R p = ovr M R' p
theorem ovr_of_not_mem {M : List (κ × β)} {p : κ} (hp : p ∉ M.map Prod.fst) (R : κ → β) : ovr M R p = R p
theorem ovr_update {M : List (κ × β)} {p : κ} (hp : p ∉ M.map Prod.fst) (R : κ → β) (y : β) : ovr M (Function.update R p y) = Function.update (ovr M R) p y
